snapshot: WHO South-East Asia Region. A federal system in which states run most services; the Union government steers through national schemes, regulation and a large public insurance programme. India chairs BRICS in 2026.

leadership.role: Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare
leadership.name: Jagat Prakash Nadda

agenda.title: Ayushman Bharat and digital health
agenda.text: The public insurance scheme and the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission remain the flagship. November reporting describes a new roadmap that brings artificial intelligence into claims handling, fraud detection and digital medical records.

agenda.title: Medicine quality and regulation
agenda.text: The government has promised immediate action against substandard medicines, including a proposal to suspend manufacturing licences at once when a product fails critical quality tests.

agenda.title: Health diplomacy through BRICS and the region
agenda.text: India holds the BRICS chair in 2026; the BRICS health ministers adopted a declaration in Chandigarh in July. In November the health minister attended the BIMSTEC health ministers' meeting in Sri Lanka.

nl.text: India and the Netherlands raised their relationship to a Strategic Partnership in May 2026.

items.title: India-Netherlands Strategic Partnership Roadmap 2026-2030
items.who: Governments of India and the Netherlands
items.text: Adopted during Prime Minister Modi's visit. Health sits in the pillar on water, agriculture and health cooperation.
